title: The First 72 Hours
subtitle: Test your grasp of The First 72 Hours — The Cut, Frequency Fracture, NPC glitching, atmospheric signs, Whitehat lockdown setup, and preparation for EBS and solar-family return.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The First 72 Hours is a surgical Frequency Fracture that severs cables, floods MSM with panic-blame, glitches NPCs, and cracks false reality so truth broadcasts can land. Sit with what you missed, then return to The First 72 Hours deep-dive, infographics, and video transmissions. Hold calm ground: this window clears the stage for Sols to anchor light, Whitehat lockdown, EBS disclosures, extraction, and the return of true solar families.

relatedTopic.label: Return to The First 72 Hours deep-dive

questions.question: What is the strategic design of the first 72 hours of the blackout timeline?

options.label: A
options.text: A permanent media festival that strengthens MSM narrative control for decades without any blackout.
options.rationale: Communications are severed and MSM floods with panic; the goal is overlay dismantling, not permanent MSM strength.

options.label: B
options.text: An accidental cable outage with no orchestration and no effect on the parasitic overlay at all.
options.rationale: The window is deliberately orchestrated to dismantle the overlay, not an accidental outage without design.

options.label: C
options.text: A voluntary internet upgrade that only improves streaming quality for sleepers worldwide.
options.rationale: Main cables are severed and fear loops are engineered; it is not a voluntary streaming upgrade.

options.label: D
options.text: A surgical, highly orchestrated window designed to dismantle the third-density parasitic overlay.
options.rationale: The first 72 hours is a surgical, highly orchestrated window built to dismantle the third-density parasitic overlay.

questions.hint: A surgical window aimed at the third-density parasitic overlay.

questions.question: How does this period push the public into a confusion and fear loop?

options.label: A
options.text: By silencing MSM completely so no panic or blame narratives can ever air during the window.
options.rationale: MSM and NPC channels are flooded with panic and blame narratives, not silenced into total quiet.

options.label: B
options.text: By restoring every cable immediately and praising only local weather reports with no geopolitical blame.
options.rationale: Cables go dark and false geopolitical blame floods channels; cables are not immediately restored for calm weather talk.

options.label: C
options.text: By severing main communication cables and pushing false blame narratives onto targets like Russia, China, and Iran.
options.rationale: Panic and a fear loop are driven by severed main cables plus false blame narratives toward Russia, China, and Iran.

options.label: D
options.text: By offering free banking apps that keep sleepers fully online without any confusion or fear.
options.rationale: The public is plunged into confusion and fear through blackout and false blame, not free apps that keep them calm online.

questions.hint: Cable action paired with false blame on named geopolitical targets.

questions.question: What necessary conditions does this blackout establish?

options.label: A
options.text: Mass glitching of background programs and cracks in false reality, establishing conditions for incoming truth broadcasts.
options.rationale: The blackout initiates mass glitching of background programs and cracks false reality so truth broadcasts can land.

options.label: B
options.text: Immediate full extraction of every sleeper with no glitching and no need for later EBS disclosures.
options.rationale: The window sets conditions for truth broadcasts and later EBS; it is not instant extraction of all sleepers without process.

options.label: C
options.text: Perfect NPC stability and a stronger false reality that blocks all future truth broadcasts forever.
options.rationale: Background programs glitch and false reality cracks; the design prepares for truth broadcasts, not permanent blockage.

options.label: D
options.text: Only better sports coverage with no effect on background programs or the false reality construct, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The blackout targets simulation scaffolding and false reality, not improved sports coverage.

questions.hint: Mass glitching, cracked false reality, and what must follow next.

questions.question: What is The Cut in this topic’s timeline?

options.label: A
options.text: The final year of reconstruction when every cable is restored and no one questions the narrative.
options.rationale: The Cut is the first 12 hours of dark communications, not a final reconstruction year of restored cables.

options.label: B
options.text: A permanent blackout lasting decades with no Opening Hour or later truth-leak phase at all, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The Cut is a 12-hour opening phase inside a 72-hour window that continues into Wave and Opening Hour.

options.label: C
options.text: The initial 12-hour phase where internet and communications go completely dark due to severed main cables.
options.rationale: The Cut is the initial 12-hour phase when internet and communications go completely dark from severed main cables.

options.label: D
options.text: Only a supermarket restock drill with fully working phones and uninterrupted MSM calm.
options.rationale: The Cut darkens internet and communications via severed cables; it is not a calm restock drill with working phones.

questions.hint: A named initial phase measured in hours, not the full 72-hour span.

questions.question: What is the Frequency Fracture?

options.label: A
options.text: The true energetic nature of the blackout, causing the parasitic overlay to wobble and crack while true memory sharpens.
options.rationale: Frequency Fracture is the blackout’s true energetic nature: the parasitic overlay wobbles and cracks, and true memory sharpens.

options.label: B
options.text: A sports-media slogan with no atmospheric pop, NPC glitching, or biological symptoms attached rather than a Frequency Fracture that cracks the overlay and sharpens true memory.
options.rationale: Frequency Fracture drives environmental and biological signs plus NPC glitching—not an empty media slogan.

options.label: C
options.text: A permanent densification of the parasitic overlay so Sol memory can never sharpen again, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: The fracture cracks the overlay and allows true memory to sharpen; it does not densify the overlay permanently.

options.label: D
options.text: A simple software patch that only restarts routers without any overlay crack or memory change rather than a Frequency Fracture that cracks the overlay and sharpens true memory.
options.rationale: Frequency Fracture is energetic overlay collapse and memory sharpening, not a mere router software patch.

questions.hint: The true energetic nature of the blackout and what it does to memory.

questions.question: What are NPCs in this 72-hour context?

options.label: A
options.text: Physical cables themselves with no behavioral glitching, aggression, or dazed quiet states instead of soulless background programs that glitch and hold the simulation together.
options.rationale: NPCs are programs in vessels that lash out or go quiet and dazed; they are not the cables alone.

options.label: B
options.text: Only Whitehat commanders who never glitch and solely author every EBS disclosure script, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: NPCs are simulation background programs that glitch; Whitehats orchestrate lockdown and EBS separately.

options.label: C
options.text: Non-player characters — background programs lacking true souls that hold the simulation together and glitch erratically during the blackout.
options.rationale: NPCs are background programs lacking true souls; they hold the simulation together and glitch heavily during the blackout.

options.label: D
options.text: Fully resonating Sols whose memory always stays sharp and who never show erratic blackout behavior, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Sols are true resonating souls; NPCs lack true souls and exhibit erratic glitching behavior.

questions.hint: Background programs, soul status, and blackout behavior.

questions.question: What is a Sol during these hours?

options.label: A
options.text: A background program without a true soul that only holds the simulation and never carries origin memory.
options.rationale: That describes NPCs; Sols are true resonating souls whose memory sharpens through the fracture.

options.label: B
options.text: A pure MSM news desk with no consciousness and no role anchoring light in the field rather than a true resonating soul whose memory sharpens through the blackout.
options.rationale: Sols are conscious resonating sparks instructed to hold ground and anchor light, not MSM desks.

options.label: C
options.text: A true resonating soul or spark of origin in a physical vessel whose memory sharpens as the blackout progresses.
options.rationale: A Sol is a true resonating soul or origin spark in a vessel; memory sharpens as the blackout progresses.

options.label: D
options.text: An elite parasite permanently immune to Frequency Fracture and later truth broadcasts rather than a true resonating soul whose memory sharpens through the blackout.
options.rationale: Sols awaken as the overlay cracks; they are not parasites immune to the 72-hour fracture.

questions.hint: Origin spark in a vessel and what happens to its memory.

questions.question: What is MSM during the initial phases?

options.label: A

options.label: B
options.text: A single offline library book with no role in the fear loop or public confusion at all, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.

options.label: C
options.text: Military-only private radios that never speak to the public and never air any panic content.
options.rationale: MSM is mainstream public media flooded with panic and blame, not silent private military radio only.

options.label: D
options.text: Mainstream media channels flooded with panic and blame narratives during the initial phases of the window.
options.rationale: MSM means mainstream media channels flooded with panic and blame narratives in the initial phases.

questions.hint: Mainstream channels and the content they are flooded with.

questions.question: Why is the 72-hour window more than a simple communications failure?

options.label: A
options.text: It permanently freezes Sol memory and perfects every NPC script without any reality questioning rather than an engineered Frequency Fracture paired with manufactured geopolitical fear.
options.rationale: Sol memory sharpens and NPCs glitch while people begin questioning narratives—not frozen Sols and perfect NPCs.

options.label: B
options.text: It only upgrades banking apps while MSM stays calm and the artificial intelligence scaffolding stays intact, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: Artificial intelligence scaffolding crumbles and MSM floods with panic; this is not a calm banking-app upgrade.

options.label: C
options.text: It is an engineered Frequency Fracture paired with manufactured geopolitical fear to glitch NPC programming and shake sleepers into questioning reality.
options.rationale: The window is an engineered Frequency Fracture; lost access plus manufactured fear glitches NPCs and shakes sleepers to question reality.

options.label: D
options.text: It is only a random weather outage with no fear manufacturing and no effect on NPC programming and no hidden harvest architecture behind the scenes.
options.rationale: The outage is engineered with manufactured geopolitical fear to glitch NPCs—not a random weather failure.

questions.hint: Engineered energetic nature paired with manufactured geopolitical fear.

questions.question: What must resonating Sols do as the artificial intelligence scaffolding crumbles?

options.label: A
options.text: Hold their ground calmly while the artificial intelligence scaffolding crumbles around the field.
options.rationale: Throughout these hours, resonating Sols must hold their ground calmly as the artificial intelligence scaffolding crumbles.

options.label: B
options.text: Rewrite MSM scripts to restore full parasitic narrative control during The Cut, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Sols hold calm presence as scaffolding crumbles; they do not restore parasitic MSM control.

options.label: C
options.text: Shut down completely and refuse to anchor any light until long after EBS ends, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Sols hold calm ground so they can later anchor light as the frequency fracture clears the stage.

options.label: D
options.text: Lead every supermarket panic surge and amplify fear loops across the largest possible crowds.
options.rationale: Sols must avoid large crowds and panic zones and hold calm ground—not lead fear surges.

questions.hint: A posture of calm ground-holding is named.

questions.question: What environmental culmination leaves the energetic field clearer than ever?

options.label: A
options.text: A permanent fog that densifies the parasitic overlay and muddies the energetic field forever.
options.rationale: The pop clears the field; it does not densify the overlay or permanently muddy the field.

options.label: B
options.text: A palpable pop in the atmosphere that leaves the energetic field clearer than ever before.
options.rationale: The environment shifts toward a palpable atmospheric pop that leaves the energetic field clearer than ever.

options.label: C
options.text: A silent legal memo with no lived atmospheric or biological experience for anyone on the ground.
options.rationale: The pop is a lived atmospheric pressure event felt in the environment, not a paper memo alone.

options.label: D
options.text: Only louder traffic noise with no pressure drop and no clearing of the energetic field.
options.rationale: Traffic noise fades into stillness before the pressure drop and pop that clear the field.

questions.hint: A named atmospheric sensation when pressure shifts.

questions.question: What defines Phase One: The Cut (Hours 0 – 12)?

options.label: A
options.text: Only Sols lose signal while MSM praises geopolitical harmony with zero fear messaging instead of Phase One cable dark and MSM panic-blame toward named geopolitical targets.
options.rationale: Communications go dark broadly and MSM floods with panic and false blame, not harmony praise.

options.label: B
options.text: EBS already airs full tribunals while every cable stays online and MSM stays perfectly calm, held as a complete closed account of the events.
options.rationale: Phase One is cable dark and panic-blame flooding; EBS comes after this catalyst window and Whitehat lockdown setup.

options.label: C
options.text: Internet and communications go dark as cables are severed; MSM and NPC channels flood with panic and false blame toward Russia, China, and Iran.
options.rationale: Phase One (0–12) darkens communications via severed cables and floods MSM and NPC channels with panic and false blame at Russia, China, and Iran.

options.label: D
options.text: Phase One only restocks fuel with no dark internet and no confusion-and-fear loop for the public instead of Phase One cable dark and MSM panic-blame toward named geopolitical targets.
options.rationale: The public is pushed into a deep loop of confusion and fear as internet goes dark—not a quiet fuel restock.

questions.hint: Dark communications and who gets flooded with panic-blame content.

questions.question: What characterizes Phase Two: The Wave (Hours 12 – 36)?

options.label: A
options.text: Everyone is ordered into the largest stadium crowds while Sols must amplify panic in every zone rather than Phase Two surges, NPC glitching, and Sols staying in small community pockets.
options.rationale: Sols are instructed to avoid large crowds and panic zones, not to fill stadiums with more panic.

options.label: B
options.text: All military vanishes and no sleeper or NPC scrambles for survival or information at all rather than Phase Two surges, NPC glitching, and Sols staying in small community pockets.
options.rationale: Sleepers and NPCs scramble for survival and information; NPC-controlled military is visible nearby.

options.label: C
options.text: Internet returns fully with calm shopping and zero visible NPC programming glitches, keeping every neighboring mechanism off the board.
options.rationale: The Wave is defined by survival scrambles and visible NPC glitching under blackout conditions.

options.label: D
options.text: Crowd surges hit supermarkets, banks, and fuel stations; NPCs glitch with aggression or dazed quiet while Sols avoid crowds in small community pockets.
options.rationale: Phase Two brings surges at stores, banks, and fuel stations; NPCs glitch aggressively or dazed while Sols stay in small community pockets.

questions.hint: Crowd targets, NPC glitch styles, and Sol guidance.

questions.question: How do military forces appear during Phase Two?

options.label: A

options.rationale: Forces are NPC-controlled and stationed nearby; Sols remain in small community pockets.

options.label: B

options.label: C

options.rationale: Military forces are visible and stationed nearby, not merely an invisible slogan.

options.rationale: During Phase Two, NPC-controlled military forces are visible and stationed nearby.

questions.hint: Control type and positioning relative to the public.

questions.question: What defines Phase Three: Opening Hour (Hours 36 – 72)?

options.label: A

options.rationale: False flags wobble and fall while Sol memory sharpens—not permanent false flags and erased Sol memory.

options.label: B

options.rationale: Opening Hour (36–72) brings heavy narrative questioning, falling false flags, Frequency Fracture truth leaks, sharpened Sol memory, and flickering NPC code.

options.label: C
options.text: All NPC code becomes flawless and no one questions MSM panic narratives during these hours.
options.rationale: People heavily question the narrative and NPC code flickers rather than perfecting itself.

options.label: D
options.text: Phase Three only restocks banks with no awakening cracks and no recognition of a Frequency Fracture.
options.rationale: Opening Hour is about awakening cracks and Frequency Fracture truth, not mere bank restocking.

questions.hint: Awakening cracks, false flags, and Sol memory versus NPC code.

questions.question: What is The Static Build-Up during the 72 hours?

options.label: A
options.text: Only stock tickers freeze while phones, power grids, birds, dogs, and cats show zero change, with every larger system treated as clean, uninvolved, or beside the point.

options.text: Subtle skull buzzing like white noise, glitching electronics and freezes, power surges, erratic birds, restless dogs near calm people, and cats disappearing to safe spots needing extra water.
options.rationale: Static Build-Up includes skull buzzing, electronic glitches, power surges, and animal reactions including cats needing extra water in safe spots.

options.text: Total silence in every skull with perfect electronics and animals completely unaffected by the field instead of Static Build-Up buzzing, glitches, surges, and animal reactions including cats.
options.rationale: Static Build-Up is buzzing, glitches, surges, and strong animal reactions—not unaffected silence.

options.label: D
options.text: A legal ban on yawning that ends all later Drop in Tone and Sharp Edge symptoms forever, and declining any account that reaches past that point instead of Static Build-Up buzzing, glitches, surges, and animal reactions including cats.

questions.hint: Skull sensation, electronics, grid, and animal behavior including cats.

questions.question: What is The Drop in Tone as experienced in these hours?

options.rationale: Drop in Tone includes deep tiredness, yawning, heavy chest, muted flat sky, and unexpected NPC emotional outbursts.

options.rationale: The sign is tiredness, muted sky, and NPC outbursts—not unlimited energy and perfect NPC calm.

options.label: D
options.text: Only bank apps crash while bodies feel light and the parasite overlay looks more solid than ever, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Drop in Tone signals overlay glitching with bodily heaviness and muted sky, not a more solid overlay.

questions.hint: Body heaviness, sky quality, and NPC emotional behavior.

questions.question: What marks The Sharp Edge, including sleeper behavior in the first 48 hours?

options.rationale: Named markers are biological adrenaline, thicker air, quieter birds, and fearful refusal to admit wrong—not louder ads alone.

options.text: A permanent end to atmospheric pop effects before any cable ever goes dark in Phase One, without extending the chain into harvest or inversion logistics instead of Sharp Edge adrenaline, thicker air, and first-48-hour refusal to admit wrong.
options.rationale: Sharp Edge is a mid-sign cluster; Silence Before the Snap and the atmospheric pop still occur around cable dark.

options.label: D
options.text: Unprovoked adrenaline and heart-rate spikes, thicker pre-storm air, fewer bird songs, and sleepers and NPCs scanning fearfully while often refusing to admit wrong or ask for help in the first 48 hours.
options.rationale: Sharp Edge brings adrenaline spikes, thicker air, fewer bird songs, and fearful scanning with refusal to admit wrong or ask for help in the first 48 hours.

questions.hint: Adrenaline, air feel, bird song, and refusal patterns among sleepers and NPCs.

questions.question: What happens in The Silence Before the Snap when cables go dark?

options.label: A

options.text: Only traffic gets louder while wind and nature grow more chaotic with no atmospheric pop at all rather than ringing stillness ending in an atmospheric pop that clears the field.
options.rationale: Traffic noise fades, wind pauses, and nature holds its breath before the pressure pop.

options.label: D
options.text: Ears ring at a high pitch, strange stillness falls, then a sudden pressure drop creates an atmospheric pop that clears the field.
options.rationale: Silence Before the Snap brings high-pitch ringing and stillness; cable dark yields a pressure pop that clears the field.

questions.hint: Hearing, stillness, then pressure change that clears the field.

questions.question: What strategic necessity does the first 72 hours serve regarding parasitic infrastructure?

options.label: A
options.text: To freeze every NPC in perfect function so no glitching or sleeper questioning ever begins.
options.rationale: Strategy forces NPCs to glitch and sleepers to question reality—not perfect frozen NPC function.

options.rationale: The blackout targets parasitic infrastructure and influence over perception, not mere retail-hour tweaks.

options.label: D
options.text: To rebuild parasitic infrastructure stronger than before with full societal collapse as the main goal.
options.rationale: The aim is controlled demolition without total collapse—not rebuilding parasites via intentional total collapse.

options.text: It isolates the population, cutting the connection between the parasites and their influence over public perception.
options.rationale: The blackout isolates the population and cuts the parasites’ connection to influence over public perception.

options.text: It changes nothing about perception because MSM panic narratives never air at any point rather than isolating the population and cutting parasitic influence over perception.

options.text: It only isolates Resonating Sols while leaving all sleepers fully plugged into parasitic feeds, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The population is isolated from usual parasitic media programming as a global pause is forced.

questions.hint: Isolation of the population and the cut connection described.

questions.hint: Anchoring action named in the strategic implications.

questions.question: What ultimate preparation does this window complete before EBS disclosures begin?

options.label: A
options.text: It prepares the realm for ultimate extraction and the return of true solar families.
options.rationale: The 72 hours prepare for extraction and return of true solar families so the public is fully focused when EBS disclosures begin.

options.label: B
options.text: It only reboots NPC grocery code with no extraction path and no solar-family return narrative.
options.rationale: Preparation is for extraction and true solar families plus EBS focus—not grocery code alone.

options.label: C
options.text: It scatters public attention so no one notices when any disclosure attempt tries to begin.
options.rationale: The design ensures the public is entirely focused when EBS begins disclosures—not scattered attention.

options.label: D
options.text: It permanently blocks extraction and ensures solar families never return while EBS stays offline forever.
options.rationale: The window prepares for extraction, solar-family return, and focused EBS disclosures—not permanent blockage.

questions.hint: Extraction path, solar families, and public focus when disclosures start.
